# 70mai multichannel fixture (synthetic)

A purely synthetic fixture for testing the multi-camera trip UI. No real
public samples of a 70mai multichannel model (S500/A810/T800) were found,
so we built one ourselves via ffmpeg testsrc2 + 1kHz sine, replicating
**only the structure** (file and folder names) seen on real SD cards from
these models.

## Structure sources

- 70mai S500 review (DashCamTalk): https://dashcamtalk.com/forum/threads/70mai-s500-rear-view-dash-camera-testing-review-rcg.50838/
  - Folders `Normal/Front`, `Normal/Back`.
  - Names `NO{YYYYMMDD}-{HHMMSS}-{counter}{F|B}.mp4`.
- 70mai T800 3CH review (DashCamTalk): https://dashcamtalk.com/forum/threads/70mai-t800-3ch-4k-front-4k-rear-1080p-cabin-dash-camera-testing-review-rcg.53323/
  - Adds `Normal/Interior` + the `I` suffix.

## What's inside

```
Normal/
  Front/
    NO20260101-120000-000001F.MP4   - 4K @ 30fps, h264, 2s
    NO20260101-120002-000002F.MP4
  Back/
    NO20260101-120000-000001B.MP4   - 1080p @ 30fps, h264, 2s
    NO20260101-120002-000002B.MP4
  Interior/
    NO20260101-120000-000001I.MP4   - 1080p @ 30fps, h264, 2s
    NO20260101-120002-000002I.MP4
GPSData000001.txt                   - $V02 log, tied only to F names
```

Every video contains a drawtext camera label ("FRONT" / "BACK" /
"INTERIOR") - in split view it's easy to see which tile shows what.

The GPS log contains 4 records (2 clips x 2 seconds @ 1 Hz). It's tied
only to the F names - mimicking real 70mai behavior (one shared log for
the whole recording, with `mp4Filename` in field [9] always pointing to
the front camera).

## Regeneration

Files are regenerated by `scripts/gen-70mai-mc-fixture.mjs`. Run:

```sh
node scripts/gen-70mai-mc-fixture.mjs
```

Idempotent - overwrites existing files.
